integrity_statement: Analytic generator matching and moment calculation establish the claim; numerical finite-difference checks only support it. Scalar Feynman-Kac and frequent-reset first-passage principles are prior work. No independent audit or scientific priority certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only one-dimensional Brownian motion with fixed-position independent Poisson resetting and absorption at zero, starting exactly at its reset point; two occupation regions split at this same point; frequent-reset limit in \(z=a\sqrt{r/D}\); no non-Poisson or interacting generalization or finite-sample inference claimed.
title: Joint absorption-time residence law and strong-reset synchronization of two Brownian regions
